assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The prototype uses synthetic records only: no real names, identity documents, phone numbers, health, housing, employment, or service records.
assumptions.impact: The package demonstrates a separation workflow but cannot establish legal identity, fraud, eligibility, or real-world service capacity.

assumptions.statement: A two-person separation request, source responsibility, downstream correction, and appeal path must be reviewed by privacy, records, accessibility, and service professionals before any field pilot.
assumptions.impact: Until review occurs, the design remains a conceptual reference scheme and must not be used as an operating identity rule.

assumptions.statement: The submitted polygons are provisional rough constraints; conceptual nodes are spatial carriers for discussion, not named institutions or selected sites.
assumptions.impact: Replace official polygons and recalculate all layers, metrics, figures, and drawings before any formal spatial conclusion.
